name: Power Electronics International, Inc.
old_description: As a world-class manufacturer of Micro-Speed® variable frequency drives and Smooth-Move® reduced torque control units, PE® equipment is world-renowned for high reliability and quality. Multi-Vector® drives also make PE® the world leader in heavy-duty closed-loop quality hoist speed control. With over a quarter of a million crane/hoist motions utilizing Power Electronics® International, Inc.® equipment, you can be assured if it's PE® then it's the best! PE® is also a UL and cUL approved manufacturer of quality control panels and automation systems.
about:
Power Electronics International, Inc. (PE) is based in East Dundee, Illinois, where it designs, engineers, and manufactures variable frequency drives, soft-starts, motor control products, and automation systems for crane and hoist applications. The company operates its own production facility in East Dundee and emphasizes that all products are made in the United States.

PE’s product line includes Micro-Speed® VFDs, Smooth-Move® reduced torque control units, Multi-Vector® closed-loop hoist drives, regeneration resistors, and a range of custom and standard control panels for travel, hoist, and multi-motion crane systems. The company also develops add-on technologies such as the PE-SAM™ sensorless anti-sway system, the PE360™ rotating hook control, PLC-based automation packages, and the Mobi-Power™ wireless power system. PE states that over 250,000 crane and hoist motions worldwide use its equipment.

The company serves the overhead crane and hoist industry, including bridge cranes, trolley systems, monorails, gantry cranes, tower cranes, and boom cranes. Its customers include crane technicians, mechanics, system integrators, and industrial material handling operations that require precise motion control and safety features.

PE differentiates itself through its Upgrade-Path™ philosophy, which ensures that programming methods for current drives remain compatible with future models, and through its UL and cUL approvals for control panels and automation systems. The company also highlights its patented sensorless anti-sway technology and heavy-duty wireless power solution as unique offerings for demanding industrial environments.
